title.zh: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC

current_state.zh: Blockstream has rejected a ransom demand from hackers who still hold nearly 600 BTC stolen from the Liquid Network, vowing to work with law enforcement and exchanges to recover the funds.
